QuestInfo.name: Path of the Wild Hunter
QuestInfo.0: You decide to become a member of the Resistance in order to fight for peace and freedom. Resistance members can choose from various Jobs to fit their aptitude and taste... You wonder what Jobs are available. Talk to #b#p2151002##k, the Bowman Job Instructor, who works as a police officer, to find out more about being a Resistance Bowman.
QuestInfo.1:
There is a big difference between a Resistance Bowman and a normal Bowman. #bWild Hunters are engage in fast and fierce battles#k by riding on animals while shooting down their enemies with their powerful crossbow! If you want to become a Wild Hunter, talk to #p2151002# again.

#bIf you want to become a different Job, forfeit the quest and talk to another Job Instructor.#k
QuestInfo.2: You've become a Wild Hunter! Show your courage and move like the wind to fight against the Black Wings as a member of the Resistance!

0.0: (Belle stretches her arms luxuriously behind her.) \r\nAhhh, it is such a treat not to have to pretend I'm frightened of every little thing that walks or crawls like I do back in town. I know we've met, but let me introduce my true self. I am #p2151002#, Bowman instructor of the Resistance.
0.1: You may think you know about Bowmen. You don't. The Bowmen of the Resistance don't stand at a distance, firing arrows like pansies. Ha! Far from it. OUR Bowmen are called #bWild Hunters#k, and we're fierce like none other.
0.2: Wild Hunters are #bmounted Bowmen#k. We attack while mounted on the back of wild creatures. And we fear nothing.
0.3: Our mounts allow us to travel fast and far, wind on our faces. It is what we live for! But don't underestimate our melee prowess, either. #bOur mounts are well-trained and can bite enemies who get too close when we are off of them#k. Wild Hunters are wild bowman who can use the mounts freely.
0.4: Some accuse us of basking in violence and say we're barbaric compared to our poised, sophisticated Bowmen counterparts. \r\n(Belle snarls.)\r\nLet them talk! Edelstein is in the danger. Ridding the town of the Black Wings is all that matters. WE have no time for idle gossip. So, will you join us? Say the word and I will turn you into a Wild Hunter.

yes.0: I love your enthusiasm! But have you really thought about this? Wild Hunters can be very powerful, but they can also be hard to control. Commanding your mount while simultaneously using your attack skills require excellent reflexes. Are you sure that you'll be able to handle it?

no.0: Not interested? Well, perhaps you should think about becoming a Battle Mage then? Talk to #p2151001# for more information on Battle Mages.
